newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Chrysalis Int'l started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Chrysalis Int'l started.

text.p: -- Vector Securities International Inc on Wednesday said it initiated coverage of Chrysalis International Corp, formerly DNX Corp, with a rating of attractive.
-- DNX's merger with BioClin International in December elevated Chrysalis International to a new level with a larger market, higher growth potential and enhanced management depth, Vector said.
-- Chrysalis International is a full-service contract reserach organization.
-- Vector said the stock was positioned to move higher in the later part of the year.
-- Vector set an earnings estimate of $0.05 a share for 1997 and $0.25 in 1998.
-- Chrysalis International shares were unchanged at 4-7/8 early Wednesday afternoon.
